Standard: The air vehicle meets the standards as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Trim Changes due to Failures paragraph, unless pilot evaluation determines the air vehicle handling qualities are no worse than Level 2. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis and simulation to assess the air vehicle flying qualities due to trim changes due to failure as specified within MIL-STD-1797, Trim Changes due to Failures paragraph for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle state, and environmental conditions. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct FMET and piloted simulations and evaluation to assess the air vehicle flying/handling qualities due to trim changes due to failures for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the air vehicle flying/handling qualities due to trim changes due to failures for selected combinations of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions.
